ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
来玩乐队啦——！！
……所以，现在该做什么好啊？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ——当然是为了感受心跳啊！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
好了赶紧把手举起来！或者Clap your hands！
我这两只手正忙着弹琴呢，气氛就拜托大家啦～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 咦？要翻唱别人的歌哦？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 绝对是玩了命地练过吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 都是一起享受音乐的伙伴

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 哦——？好伤人啊～我可是很敏感的哦？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 是那样没错啦……茉幌，你有什么点子吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 像是想传达的事情，或是想抒发出来的情感

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
听到好音乐就要把手举起来！
和我一起嗨起来吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
就是你，说・你・呢！
那个看着像只垂头丧气小狗一样的家伙！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我们5人，就是millsage！
差不多该让音乐响起来了吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 喂喂喂～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 随便你弹！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 真不坦率啊～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 上啊，就差一点！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 当然！我很期待哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 好，那我就开始了！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
证明我在这世上真真切切活过的印记。
不走这一遭人生，就不会诞生的东西

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
没有啦，要翻唱也不是不行，
但既然都要玩乐队了，当然会想写原创曲吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 嗯……我猜，写歌词的人根本什么也没想吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
写歌词的人就只是把那些东西一口气写下来，
等回过神来，文字就已经变成歌词了吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
然后最后是！
键盘兼主唱，泽海奏多！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 好——！最棒的乐队时光开始啦～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 让我来介绍一下我最棒的乐队成员吧！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_000
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
来玩乐队啦——！！
……所以，现在该做什么好啊？

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_001
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: ——当然是为了感受心跳啊！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_002
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
好了赶紧把手举起来！或者Clap your hands！
我这两只手正忙着弹琴呢，气氛就拜托大家啦～！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_003
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 咦？要翻唱别人的歌哦？

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_004
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 绝对是玩了命地练过吧！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_005
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 都是一起享受音乐的伙伴

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_006
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 哦——？好伤人啊～我可是很敏感的哦？

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_007
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 是那样没错啦……茉幌，你有什么点子吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_008
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 像是想传达的事情，或是想抒发出来的情感

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_009
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
听到好音乐就要把手举起来！
和我一起嗨起来吧！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_010
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
就是你，说・你・呢！
那个看着像只垂头丧气小狗一样的家伙！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_011
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
我们5人，就是millsage！
差不多该让音乐响起来了吧！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_012
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 喂喂喂～！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_013
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 随便你弹！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_014
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 真不坦率啊～

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_015
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 上啊，就差一点！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_016
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 当然！我很期待哦！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_017
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 好，那我就开始了！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_018
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
证明我在这世上真真切切活过的印记。
不走这一遭人生，就不会诞生的东西

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_019
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
没有啦，要翻唱也不是不行，
但既然都要玩乐队了，当然会想写原创曲吧！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_020
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 嗯……我猜，写歌词的人根本什么也没想吧？

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_021
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
写歌词的人就只是把那些东西一口气写下来，
等回过神来，文字就已经变成歌词了吧

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_022
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
然后最后是！
键盘兼主唱，泽海奏多！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_023
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 好——！最棒的乐队时光开始啦～！

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_024
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 让我来介绍一下我最棒的乐队成员吧！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 像是想传达的事情，或是想抒发出来的情感

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
听到好音乐就要把手举起来！
和我一起嗨起来吧！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
就是你，说・你・呢！
那个看着像只垂头丧气小狗一样的家伙！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
我们5人，就是millsage！
差不多该让音乐响起来了吧！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 喂喂喂～！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 随便你弹！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 真不坦率啊～

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 上啊，就差一点！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 当然！我很期待哦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 好，那我就开始了！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
证明我在这世上真真切切活过的印记。
不走这一遭人生，就不会诞生的东西

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
没有啦，要翻唱也不是不行，
但既然都要玩乐队了，当然会想写原创曲吧！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 嗯……我猜，写歌词的人根本什么也没想吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
写歌词的人就只是把那些东西一口气写下来，
等回过神来，文字就已经变成歌词了吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
然后最后是！
键盘兼主唱，泽海奏多！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 好——！最棒的乐队时光开始啦～！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 让我来介绍一下我最棒的乐队成员吧！
